baseline_sources.source_title: Dispositional Order of Direct Contempt, State v. Sandoval, No. S-1-SC-40845
baseline_sources.source_platform: Thomson Reuters-hosted copy of New Mexico Supreme Court order
baseline_sources.evidence_status_basis: The court's signed dispositional order directly records the attorney's admissions concerning ChatGPT use, fabricated and false testimony, misrepresented legal authority, failure to verify before filing, and the sanctions and procedural remedies imposed by the court.
